div.div:
the constraint set
Sv = 0: exact when the alternation ends on the balance, else a residual
lb ≤ v ≤ ub: exact when it ends on the box, else a penalty
second law vj ΔGj ≤ 0: a hinge, or with tdg a directional box
protein pool Σg MWg Eg ≤ pavail: a hinge
Gibbs dissipation: a logged diagnostic; the anchored registry entry carried it as a hinge at nonzero constraint scale
